description: Desktop Commander onboarding prompts customized for 9 Turnbull Court PMO

prompts.title: Process New Project Documents
prompts.description: Scan and organize new project documents from your Downloads folder into the 9TC document register.
prompts.prompt:
Let's process new 9TC project documents! 📄

I'll help you organize documents from your Downloads folder into the project structure.

**What type of documents are you importing?**
- Invoices & Payment Requests
- RFI (Request for Information) correspondence
- Construction Drawings & Plans
- Permits & Approvals
- Supplier Specifications
- Site Photos & Progress Reports
- Variation Orders / Change Orders
- Meeting Minutes

Let me scan your Downloads folder and we'll classify and organize them automatically!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Analyze Project Drawings & Plans
prompts.description: Extract and organize construction drawings, identify revisions, and manage CAD files for 9TC.
prompts.prompt:
Let's organize your 9TC construction drawings! 🏗️

I can help you:
- Identify and catalog all construction drawings
- Track drawing revisions and superseded plans
- Extract plan details and specifications
- Organize by type (Floor Plans, Elevations, Sections, Details)
- Create a drawing register

**Where are your drawings located?** (e.g., ~/9TC-Project-Data/Drawings)

I'll organize them and create a master drawing register for easy tracking!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Invoice & Payment Tracking
prompts.description: Extract invoice data, track payments, and identify overdue accounts for the 9TC project.
prompts.prompt:
Let's track 9TC project invoices and payments! 💰

I'll help you:
- Extract invoice data (supplier, amount, due date, GST)
- Identify overdue payments
- Reconcile paid vs. unpaid invoices
- Generate supplier payment summaries
- Flag budget variances

**Where are your invoices stored?** (e.g., ~/9TC-Project-Data/Invoices)

I can connect to your invoice register and keep your payment tracking up to date!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: RFI (Request for Information) Management
prompts.description: Track, organize, and follow up on RFI correspondence and responses for 9TC.
prompts.prompt:
Let's manage your 9TC RFI (Request for Information) register! ✉️

I can help you:
- Scan and log new RFI requests
- Track response dates and status
- Identify overdue RFI responses
- Organize by trades or building systems
- Generate RFI status reports
- Flag critical or blocking RFIs

**Where are your RFI documents stored?**

I'll organize them and help keep your RFI tracking current and prevent delays!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Permits & Approvals Tracking
prompts.description: Track building permits, council approvals, and compliance certifications for 9TC.
prompts.prompt:
Let's track 9TC permits and approvals! ✅

I'll help you:
- Catalog all building permits and approvals
- Track approval dates and valid periods
- Identify expired or expiring permits
- Monitor compliance certificate status
- Generate permit status reports
- Flag critical deadlines

**Where are your permits and approvals stored?**

I'll organize them and help you stay on top of regulatory requirements!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Variation Orders & Change Management
prompts.description: Track variation orders, change orders, and budget impacts for 9TC.
prompts.prompt:
Let's manage 9TC variation orders and changes! 📋

I can help you:
- Log all variation orders and change orders
- Extract cost impacts and schedule changes
- Track approval status
- Calculate cumulative variations
- Generate change impact reports
- Flag budget or schedule risks

**Where are your variation orders stored?**

I'll organize them and help track the financial and schedule impacts of all changes!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Site Progress & Photo Documentation
prompts.description: Organize and catalog site progress photos and visual documentation for 9TC.
prompts.prompt:
Let's organize 9TC site progress photos! 📸

I can help you:
- Catalog all site progress photos
- Tag photos by location, trade, or date
- Create visual progress reports
- Extract metadata (date, camera info)
- Organize photos chronologically
- Generate visual milestone documentation

**Where are your site photos stored?**

I'll help you create a visual record of project progress!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Supplier & Contractor Database
prompts.description: Build and maintain a supplier and contractor database for 9TC with contact and performance data.
prompts.prompt:
Let's build your 9TC supplier and contractor database! 📇

I can help you:
- Extract supplier/contractor details from invoices and correspondence
- Create a master contact list with phone/email
- Track performance ratings and feedback
- Organize by trade or service type
- Generate supplier reports
- Identify key contacts and escalation paths

I'll create a comprehensive contractor and supplier database from your existing documents!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Generate 9TC Project Status Report
prompts.description: Create comprehensive project status reports with key metrics, risks, and upcoming milestones.
prompts.prompt:
Let's generate a 9TC project status report! 📊

I'll analyze and summarize:
- Current construction progress and completion %
- Budget status vs. variations
- Outstanding payments and cash flow
- Overdue RFIs and their impact
- Permit and approval status
- Risk and issue register
- Next steps and critical path items
- Upcoming milestones

I'll create a comprehensive executive summary of the current project state!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team

prompts.title: Meeting Minutes & Action Items
prompts.description: Extract and organize meeting minutes, track action items and owner responsibilities.
prompts.prompt:
Let's organize 9TC meeting minutes and action items! 📝

I can help you:
- Extract and catalog meeting minutes
- Identify all action items and owners
- Track completion status
- Flag overdue actions
- Create action item registers by owner
- Generate meeting summaries
- Track decisions and approvals

**Where are your meeting minutes stored?**

I'll create an action item tracking system and keep everyone accountable!
prompts.author: 9TC PMO Team
